name: Fate King
source:
You wake up without remembering anything, now you are captured and taken to a castle where you will live torments. Will you fall for the pleasures of your body or will you resist to seek revenge?

[From F95Zone]
translation:
你醒来时失去了所有记忆。如今你被抓住，带到一座城堡，等待你的将是无尽折磨。你会屈从于肉体的快感，还是忍耐下来，伺机复仇？

[来源：F95Zone]
